newsitem.title: USA: Lehman closes gold trading operations.
newsitem.headline: Lehman closes gold trading operations.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. said Friday it has closed its gold trading operations and laid off 11 commodity traders, and industry sources said further restructuring of its global metals operations was on the way.

"The changes affect eight precious metals traders in New York and London, and three natural gas traders in New York," a spokesman for the investment bank said. "That is the extent of everything we've done this week."
The layoffs were part of a "typical reallocation of resources", the spokesman said, adding that no further layoffs were planned at this time.
A company spokesman also confirmed the gold trading desk had been closed, but no further details were immediately available.
Lehman staff members confirmed a restructuring of some of the bank's commodity trading operations was underway.

Industry sources said staff layoffs would affect most of Lehman's precious metals traders, some natural gas traders, and some base metals traders in London. Base metals include copper, zinc and aluminum.
"It wouldn't surprise me given that people have not made a lot of money in metal trading lately," said Raphael Soifer, an analyst at Brown Brothers Harriman who tracks Lehman.
